_comment: No Figma component — used in the KYC and profile flows. Built from the Frontend per the amended authority rule (2026-08-20), stripped of its API coupling: the Frontend version owns upload polling (getUploadUrl/getUploadStatus); the library version is presentational and hands the file to the caller.

_source.field: `h-10 rounded-l-md border p-2` — 40 / 6 / 8. Name box border `border-grey-light` = #d4d4d4 = border.accent.gray-light; warning state swaps it for border.error. Button is the primary-red block with rounded right corners.
_source.chips: edit / remove overlays on the preview: `bg-dark rounded-md` — background.dark is the same secondary-default the Frontend aliases as bg-dark.
_source.icons: filled-gallery (picker + empty state), filled-close (remove), filled-Warning-2 (name-box warning). The Frontend's warning-icon-filled has no exact twin in the set; filled-Warning-2 is the set's warning glyph and matches the alert's.
_source.stripped: Upload orchestration, status polling and the failure DialogModal stay app-side; the component exposes onSelect/onRemove/state instead.
_source.icon-sizes: The Frontend draws the field's warning glyph at 22 and the empty-state gallery at 40. 22 is not a stop on the icon scale (12/16/20/24/32/40/…), so it snaps to 20 — the size Alert gives the same glyph. 40 is already a stop (xl) and is kept.

_frontend_evidence.states: empty (dashed dropzone + hint) / uploading (spinner) / preview (image + edit + remove chips) / warning (red border + icon + message)

_verified_from.scope: token mirror searched for upload/gallery/attach; frontend component + module css read in full
_verified_from.result: VERIFIED ABSENT in Figma. Frontend is the authority per the amended rule (user decision 2026-08-20).
